dedupe_keys.name: crowdsourced weekly basic public service delivery indicators for venezuela electricity cooking gas garbage

description: This dataset tracks delivery of basic public services in Venezuela from reports crowdsourced monthly from residents through the Premise Data mobile application, giving indicators for electricity, cooking gas and garbage disposal at weekly granularity from July 2020. It is published by Code for Venezuela, with Angostura named as the source, on the Humanitarian Data Exchange as a single downloadable CSV file under the Open Data Commons Open Database Licence, and the HDX entry lists the method as a sample survey. Caveats: reports come from app users, not a probability sample of households, the HDX entry was last modified in December 2021, and indicator definitions are explained only through the linked Premise material. It is useful for calibrating service performance and outage frequency in resilience and cascading failure models, and for emergency response planning; a related record is the Wikimpacts climate impact database.
